exposure: fetal pulmonary artery acceleration time to ejection time (At/Et) ratio
cohort: One hundred seventy-five pregnant women with uncomplicated pregnancies who delivered after 37 gestational weeks, including those with small for gestational age (SGA) fetuses and a healthy control group, with their neonates subsequently diagnosed for TTN.
finding: The fetal pulmonary artery At/Et was significantly lower in the SGA group and inversely correlated with TTN, indicating its potential as a noninvasive predictor for TTN in term SGA newborns with a cut-off value of 0.298.
cross-section timing: Fetal pulmonary artery At/Et was determined antenatally via ultrasound; TTN diagnosis was made postnatally in the neonatal period.
birth_weight: Neonates were categorized based on birth weight percentiles as Small for Gestational Age (SGA) or healthy control (Appropriate for Gestational Age).
